requirements.text: With your parent or legal guardian, talk about your family’s faith traditions. Identify three holidays or celebrations that are part of your family’s faith traditions. Make a craft, work of art, or a food item that is part of your family’s faith traditions.
Carry out an act of kindness.
With your parent or legal guardian identify a religion or faith that is different from your own. Identify two things that it has in common with your family’s beliefs.
Discuss with our parent or legal guardian what it means to be reverent. Tell how you practice being reverent in your daily life.

provenance.notes: Requirement text verbatim from the adventure's official page.
